raw: [Subtitle(text="Sir, are you saying such a remarkable individual actually existed in the history of Great Yan?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Sir, are you saying such a remarkable individual actually existed in the history of Great Yan?

raw: [Subtitle(text="Yes...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]

[Subtitle(text="Cataloging books, organizing texts, promoting education... if she did so much for all life under Heaven, why does no one remember her, or even know her name?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Cataloging books, organizing texts, promoting education... if she did so much for all life under Heaven, why does no one remember her, or even know her name?

raw: [Subtitle(text="Sir, can you identify this character? I don't believe I've ever encountered it before.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Sir, can you identify this character? I don't believe I've ever encountered it before.

raw: [Subtitle(text="It's not that no one remembers her. It's simply that her 'true name in one lone word' was never recorded in the history books.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: It's not that no one remembers her. It's simply that her 'true name in one lone word' was never recorded in the history books.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Isn't it a pity? Her pen captured Great Yan's long history and vast expanse, yet not a single page in the historical records bears her name.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Isn't it a pity? Her pen captured Great Yan's long history and vast expanse, yet not a single page in the historical records bears her name.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Sir, if I were to complete all the missing records, do you think I could reconstruct her image?", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Sir, if I were to complete all the missing records, do you think I could reconstruct her image?

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", text="Forty years ago...", x=320,y=340, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.001, width=700,block = true,duration=1)]
[animtext(id = "at1", name = "group_location_stamp", style="avg_only_medium", pos = "-400,-200", block = false)]<p=2>April 21st, 1062      Guyu (Grain Rain)</>
content: <p=2>April 21st, 1062      Guyu (Grain Rain)</>

speaker: Hawking Shopworker
content: Sir, sir!

raw: [name="Hawking Shopworker"]It's raining so hard out there. Why not come inside, have a pot of nice, warm tea, and wait out the rain?
speaker: Hawking Shopworker
content: It's raining so hard out there. Why not come inside, have a pot of nice, warm tea, and wait out the rain?

raw: [name="Calm Man"]No need. This rain won't be stopping anytime soon—I should keep moving.
speaker: Calm Man
content: No need. This rain won't be stopping anytime soon—I should keep moving.

raw: [name="Hawking Shopworker"]Haha. Some people want the rain to stop, some hope it carries on.
speaker: Hawking Shopworker
content: Haha. Some people want the rain to stop, some hope it carries on.

raw: [name="Hawking Shopworker"]The umbrella vendor is smiling from ear to ear, but the passersby are downright miserable.
speaker: Hawking Shopworker
content: The umbrella vendor is smiling from ear to ear, but the passersby are downright miserable.

speaker: Calm Man
content: A fascinating thought...

raw: [name="Hawking Shopworker"]Friend, you should take a moment to rest. I was asked to remind you: the road ahead is rough and uneven. A certain someone worries you might misstep, and get your shoes wet.
speaker: Hawking Shopworker
content: Friend, you should take a moment to rest. I was asked to remind you: the road ahead is rough and uneven. A certain someone worries you might misstep, and get your shoes wet.

speaker: Calm Man
content: Hmm?

raw: [name="Hawking Shopworker"]Please just follow me, sir. Your friend is already waiting for you inside.
speaker: Hawking Shopworker
content: Please just follow me, sir. Your friend is already waiting for you inside.

speaker: Shuo
content: High Minister... it's been a while.

raw: [name="Shuo"]No... These days, you're... the Grand Tutor.
speaker: Shuo
content: No... These days, you're... the Grand Tutor.

raw: [name="???"]It has been some time indeed, since we bid each other farewell in Yumen.
content: It has been some time indeed, since we bid each other farewell in Yumen.

raw: [name="Shuo"]I expected to meet with the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of War first upon this return to the capital to deliver my report.
speaker: Shuo
content: I expected to meet with the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of War first upon this return to the capital to deliver my report.

raw: [name="???"]That's why I've arranged to meet with you in advance.
content: That's why I've arranged to meet with you in advance.
His Imperial Majesty... has passed.

speaker: Shuo
content: When?
Two weeks ago.

raw: [name="Shuo"]I think... if His Majesty had died of natural causes, you would not be coming to see me about it.
speaker: Shuo
content: I think... if His Majesty had died of natural causes, you would not be coming to see me about it.

speaker: Shuo
content: Does this mean...?

raw: The man sitting in the shadows holds out his hand. A black weiqi stone rests in his palm.
content: The man sitting in the shadows holds out his hand. A black weiqi stone rests in his palm.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]Sixty years ago, he escaped from that ancient temple and turned himself into one hundred eighty-one black weiqi stones, which scattered across the lands. Their current whereabouts are unknown.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Sixty years ago, he escaped from that ancient temple and turned himself into one hundred eighty-one black weiqi stones, which scattered across the lands. Their current whereabouts are unknown.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]Two weeks ago, the Sui Regulator found this stone in the capital.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Two weeks ago, the Sui Regulator found this stone in the capital.

speaker: Shuo
content: What... has he done?

speaker: Grand Tutor
content: I do not know.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]The only thing I'm certain of is that he could not have entered the Forbidden City... someone must have gone out to meet him.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: The only thing I'm certain of is that he could not have entered the Forbidden City... someone must have gone out to meet him.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]Investigating this person's identity would be... sensitive.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Investigating this person's identity would be... sensitive.

raw: [name="Shuo"]His machinations likely will not involve others.
speaker: Shuo
content: His machinations likely will not involve others.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]I shouldn't have come to you today, but when the convict caused all this turmoil before, you were the one who subdued him.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: I shouldn't have come to you today, but when the convict caused all this turmoil before, you were the one who subdued him.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]Grandmaster, do you know anything of this?
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Grandmaster, do you know anything of this?

speaker: Shuo
content: Not a thing...

raw: [name="Shuo"]I have not seen him, since the incident.
speaker: Shuo
content: I have not seen him, since the incident.

speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Then I believe you, Grandmaster.

speaker: Shuo
content: Do you need anything from me?

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]Do not linger here. Return to Yumen at once.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Do not linger here. Return to Yumen at once.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]Ursus is in constant turmoil, and there is a changing of the guard in Yumen. We must not allow morale to be shaken.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Ursus is in constant turmoil, and there is a changing of the guard in Yumen. We must not allow morale to be shaken.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]I will handle the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of War myself. It is precisely because you are not entangled in this affair that I can entrust you with such a crucial task.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: I will handle the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of War myself. It is precisely because you are not entangled in this affair that I can entrust you with such a crucial task.

speaker: Shuo
content: Understood.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]I will see the Sui Regulator continue to investigate the weiqi matter in secret.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: I will see the Sui Regulator continue to investigate the weiqi matter in secret.

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]During this crucial time, you should remain out of sight, Grandmaster. We did not meet here today.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: During this crucial time, you should remain out of sight, Grandmaster. We did not meet here today.

raw: [name="Shuo"]Regarding the True Lung... how is His Highness Yan Wu?
speaker: Shuo
content: Regarding the True Lung... how is His Highness Yan Wu?

speaker: Shuo
content: At this moment, he should be—

speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Yan Wu...

raw: [name="Grand Tutor"]Yan Wu was the one who went to His Imperial Majesty... on the night he died.
speaker: Grand Tutor
content: Yan Wu was the one who went to His Imperial Majesty... on the night he died.

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]Your Highness, twenty-eight members of the traitor's family have been imprisoned.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: Your Highness, twenty-eight members of the traitor's family have been imprisoned.

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]But after we checked the list, we found there was a single individual missing—an infant just under a month old.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: But after we checked the list, we found there was a single individual missing—an infant just under a month old.

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]The Imperial Guard searched the Grand Preceptor's mansion thoroughly today, but found no traces of the baby.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: The Imperial Guard searched the Grand Preceptor's mansion thoroughly today, but found no traces of the baby.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]A newborn could not have run off by herself.
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: A newborn could not have run off by herself.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]Someone went through the trouble to whisk her away.
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: Someone went through the trouble to whisk her away.

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]Your Highness need not worry. The Imperial Guard will find her.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: Your Highness need not worry. The Imperial Guard will find her.

speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: Hmph...

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]Earlier today, the Minister of Justice requested a meeting.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: Earlier today, the Minister of Justice requested a meeting.

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]He seeks His Highness's advice on this series of cases.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: He seeks His Highness's advice on this series of cases.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]Handle them... according to the Laws of Yan.
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: Handle them... according to the Laws of Yan.

speaker: Grand Commandant
content: I'll tell him.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]Where is my elder brother now?
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: Where is my elder brother now?

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]According to our reports, he left the capital just half an hour ago. Some of the Imperial Guard have defected with him.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: According to our reports, he left the capital just half an hour ago. Some of the Imperial Guard have defected with him.

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]The soldiers guarding the city did not dare to stop them, without orders to do so.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: The soldiers guarding the city did not dare to stop them, without orders to do so.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]Indeed... I never ordered them to keep him in Baizao.
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: Indeed... I never ordered them to keep him in Baizao.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]He was unwilling to stay and left everyone behind.
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: He was unwilling to stay and left everyone behind.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]How many Imperial Guardsmen went with him?
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: How many Imperial Guardsmen went with him?

speaker: Grand Commandant
content: Eighteen.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]Even after committing such an unforgivable crime, my elder brother can still send the Grand Preceptor to die in his place; he can still command the unwavering loyalty of these eighteen deathsworn.
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: Even after committing such an unforgivable crime, my elder brother can still send the Grand Preceptor to die in his place; he can still command the unwavering loyalty of these eighteen deathsworn.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]How many courtiers are still devoted to him? How many still hope that he will retake the throne?
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: How many courtiers are still devoted to him? How many still hope that he will retake the throne?

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]Yet it is Your Highness who now sits on the throne, not him. Therefore, it falls upon Your Highness to ensure Yan's eternal prosperity.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: Yet it is Your Highness who now sits on the throne, not him. Therefore, it falls upon Your Highness to ensure Yan's eternal prosperity.

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]All castes of Yan may afford hesitation and uncertainty... save Your Highness.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: All castes of Yan may afford hesitation and uncertainty... save Your Highness.

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]It's been so long since I've left this palace... Grand Commandant, tell me——
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: It's been so long since I've left this palace... Grand Commandant, tell me——

raw: [name="Voice Behind the Curtain"]Has the spring rain yet ceased, in Baizao?
speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: Has the spring rain yet ceased, in Baizao?

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]The rain may stop whenever Your Highness desires.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: The rain may stop whenever Your Highness desires.

raw: [name="Grand Commandant"]If Your Highness has changed your mind, you yet have time to stop them.
speaker: Grand Commandant
content: If Your Highness has changed your mind, you yet have time to stop them.

speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: ...I'm exhausted.

raw: [name="Attendant"]The Imperial Kitchen has prepared some babao soup and shredded bamboo shoots. If Your Highness desires?
speaker: Attendant
content: The Imperial Kitchen has prepared some babao soup and shredded bamboo shoots. If Your Highness desires?

speaker: Voice Behind the Curtain
content: Very well.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=-1, xstrength=3, ystrength=3, vibrato=15, randomness=90, fadeout=false, block=false)]
[CameraShake(duration=-1, xstrength=2, ystrength=2, vibrato=5, randomness=90, fadeout=false, block=false)]

speaker: Gentle Woman
content: There... there...

raw: [name="Gentle Woman"]Don't cry. We're on our way home. We're almost there.
speaker: Gentle Woman
content: Don't cry. We're on our way home. We're almost there.

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]Pick up the pace, please... if you could.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: Pick up the pace, please... if you could.

raw: [name="Coachman"]It's raining too hard. And I can't see too well. Couldn't go any faster, at this rate...
speaker: Coachman
content: It's raining too hard. And I can't see too well. Couldn't go any faster, at this rate...

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]How much farther to the next stage station?
speaker: Anxious Man
content: How much farther to the next stage station?

speaker: Coachman
content: At least thirty li...

raw: [name="Coachman"]Brother, just how urgent is your business... that you'd bring your whole family along to travel on a night like this?
speaker: Coachman
content: Brother, just how urgent is your business... that you'd bring your whole family along to travel on a night like this?

speaker: Anxious Man
content: Please... just go faster.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Coachman
content: Ahhh! Ahhh!! What the——

raw: [CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=15, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Coachman"]*Yanese exclamation* What's somebody doing out here in the wilderness at this hour?
speaker: Coachman
content: *Yanese exclamation* What's somebody doing out here in the wilderness at this hour?

raw: The man looks around, but the endless rain blocks his view. It is too dark for him to see anything.
content: The man looks around, but the endless rain blocks his view. It is too dark for him to see anything.

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]We'll have to get out here.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: We'll have to get out here.

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]Sir, I'll give you all the money I have. Take your carriage to the next stage station. If anyone asks, do not tell them you carried passengers with a baby tonight.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: Sir, I'll give you all the money I have. Take your carriage to the next stage station. If anyone asks, do not tell them you carried passengers with a baby tonight.

speaker: Anxious Man
content: I beseech you, good sir.

speaker: Coachman
content: But.... what... huh?!

raw: [name="Coachman"]Where are you going in this weather?
speaker: Coachman
content: Where are you going in this weather?

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]We'll follow the path through the northern woods.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: We'll follow the path through the northern woods.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Panicked Woman
content: Ahhhh!!!!!

speaker: Anxious Man
content: What is it?

speaker: Panicked Woman
content: The baby...

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=15, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Panicked Woman
content: The baby is gone...

speaker: Silent Old Man
content: It's... it's her.

raw: The baby is sleeping soundly in her cradle, oblivious to the mud and blood on her face.
content: The baby is sleeping soundly in her cradle, oblivious to the mud and blood on her face.

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]I did everything you asked.
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: I did everything you asked.

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]I know their methods, and I know how to answer them. Don't worry. I won't allow any blood to stain you.
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: I know their methods, and I know how to answer them. Don't worry. I won't allow any blood to stain you.

raw: [name="Silent Old Man"]Good sir, I have no way to repay your kindness.
speaker: Silent Old Man
content: Good sir, I have no way to repay your kindness.

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]No. You need not thank me. I did not do this for you.
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: No. You need not thank me. I did not do this for you.

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]She's done so much for me, yet what I do today will neither clear her name nor even begin to avenge her.
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: She's done so much for me, yet what I do today will neither clear her name nor even begin to avenge her.

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]I have no family and no affairs to settle after my death. I ask only one favor of you.
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: I have no family and no affairs to settle after my death. I ask only one favor of you.

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]Please, take this girl in.
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: Please, take this girl in.

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]You need not tell her anything. Just let her grow up and live her life in peace.
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: You need not tell her anything. Just let her grow up and live her life in peace.

raw: [name="Silent Old Man"]You know... if she stays here, it will be risky, with a greater possibility that this old case will be reopened.
speaker: Silent Old Man
content: You know... if she stays here, it will be risky, with a greater possibility that this old case will be reopened.

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]But isn't that what you want?
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: But isn't that what you want?

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]We may be powerless to change the situation right now...
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: We may be powerless to change the situation right now...

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]But if one day, be it three or four decades later, the truth is revealed...
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: But if one day, be it three or four decades later, the truth is revealed...

raw: [name="Man with Bloody Hands"]All the blood shall not have been shed in vain.
speaker: Man with Bloody Hands
content: All the blood shall not have been shed in vain.

raw: [name="Silent Old Man"]Right then. I swear it.
speaker: Silent Old Man
content: Right then. I swear it.
